title: Landing page — resort
description: Complete resort landing page: photo hero, feature cards, split story, stats, gallery, testimonials, call to action over photo and footer, with onload and scroll animations.

Text-landing-resort-body-3.value: Watch the sun set from a private terrace, then let the kitchen take care of the rest.

Text-landing-resort-body-10.value: One person who knows your plans and your coffee order.

Text-landing-resort-body-14.value: Treatments in rooms carved into the rock above the sea.

Text-landing-resort-body-18.value: Daily departures from our jetty, crew and canapés included.

Text-landing-resort-body-22.value: A dedicated host looks after each suite, from airport pickup to the last late checkout.

Text-landing-resort-h2-26.value: Breakfast with a view of the bay

Text-landing-resort-body-27.value: Our terrace restaurant serves from sunrise to late evening, with a menu built around the morning catch and island fruit.
